ContributionProfit.formula: Adjusted Gross Profit (Loss) - holding costs incurred in current period - holding costs incurred in prior periods - direct selling costs (all on homes sold during the current period)

AdjustedGrossProfit.formula_2021: GAAP gross profit + inventory impairment current period - inventory impairment prior periods + restructuring in cost of revenue
AdjustedGrossProfit.formula_2025: GAAP gross profit + inventory valuation adjustment current period - inventory valuation adjustment prior periods
AdjustedGrossProfit.definition_drift: 'inventory impairment' relabelled 'inventory valuation adjustment'; restructuring adjustment no longer present

ContributionProfitAfterInterest.formula: Contribution Profit - interest expense under senior revolving credit facilities incurred on homes sold during the period (may include interest recorded in prior periods)
